title.subtitle: The Flame never sleeps. Neither do you.

hud.rested: The hydra sleeps in its lair. Wounds close. Burnt stumps itch, and sprout.
hud.outOfReach: Too far to reach this turn.
hud.noWayThere: There is no known way there.
hud.journeyWaits: No movement left. End the turn to travel on.
hud.silenced: The Silent Bell hums. The Order heard nothing.
hud.tunnelBored: The Cinderkin melt a tunnel through the rock, to the {direction}. It will burn for a while.
hud.boreFailed: The swarm finds no rock thin enough nearby, and drifts off to look for some.
hud.burned: The tunnel is still molten. Body {n}.

event.//: The panel of an event on the map (events.json). {quest}: the mini quest's name. {n}: an amount. {cost}: what a choice costs. {name}: a condition's or head class's name.

dialogue.//: The dialogue screen. tapToContinue: the small hint in the corner.

battle.hintSelectHead:
Tap a head, then an enemy. Heads that gang up on one enemy can combo.
Tap a free hex to move the body. Press Resume when ready.
battle.victoryTitle: The Order retreats. Mostly into you.
battle.//skills: M2a. aim*: the hint while the player aims a skill ({skill}: its name). hintSkills: shown with the skill buttons before the battle starts.
battle.hintSkills: Q, W: this head's skills. Before you start, ⇄ swaps in its third one.

shrine.title: A shrine of the Great Serpent

lineages.//: M6, generations (GAME_DESIGN.md §12): the title's buttons, the screen after a death, the Book of Lineages, mutations on the map. {name}: a hydra's name with its number (or a mutation's or modifier's name); {lineage}: her lineage's name (its first hydra's); {generation}: her generation; {turns}: turns she lived; {n}: a number with its sign; {list}: names, with commas.
lineages.awaiting: The Line of {lineage}: an heiress waits to hatch
lineages.confirmBody: {name} goes into the Book of Lineages as the last of her line. What she learned of the world stays. Her mutations go with her.
lineages.inheritsNothing: Nothing. The heiress will have to make her own mistakes.
lineages.bookEmpty: No hydra has lived yet. The book waits, with the patience of paper.
lineages.markTitle: A marking shrine of the Great Serpent
lineages.markWords: A mark for her and every heiress after her.
